faq.q: What is the Cekat.AI sales solution?
faq.a: An AI agent, CRM, and follow-up automation working as one. The AI replies to and qualifies leads from every chat channel, while the CRM records contacts, history, and deal stages automatically through to closing.

faq.q: How is this different from a regular CRM?
faq.a: A regular CRM records things after the fact and depends on salespeople filling it in. In Cekat.AI the conversation, qualification, and follow-up happen on the same platform, so the pipeline fills itself from chat.

faq.q: How does the AI know which leads are hot?
faq.a: You define the qualifying questions, such as budget, needs, and timing. The AI asks them naturally in conversation and tags the answers on the contact, so sales just filters.

faq.q: When does the AI hand a chat to a human?
faq.a: On the rules you set: when a prospect asks to talk to someone, when deal value is high, or when certain keywords appear. The AI stops and your team takes over with the full history on the same screen.

faq.q: Which channels can the sales team use?
faq.a: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, and website live chat, all landing in one inbox and one shared pipeline.
A first bot can be live in about 5 minutes with no code: connect a channel, upload product knowledge, set the qualification flow. Follow-up sequences and pipeline tuning come after.

faq.q: Do we have to change our WhatsApp number?
faq.a: No. The business number your customers already know connects through the WhatsApp Business API, including the green checkmark if you meet Meta's verification requirements.

faq.q: What reporting do sales managers get?
faq.a: Deal value per pipeline stage, incoming lead counts per channel and ad source, each rep's response speed, and the deals that have sat still the longest. All readable directly, with no manual recap requested from the team.
